message.content: In the month of May, Hailey Johnson offered several special offerings at her bakery. A notable event was a free baking class hosted on a weekend, which Li Hua expressed interest in attending. Additionally, there was a special summer promotion on ice cream and pastries, where Li Hua shared her preferences for summer desserts, indicating a focus on fruity flavors such as mango and coconut. There was also a bread-tasting event scheduled from 10 am to 2 pm on Saturday, inviting Li Hua to gather feedback from customers, showcasing her commitment to engaging with her clientele to enhance her offerings. Furthermore, in a series of delivery messages, Alice, who works at Hailey's Bakery, confirmed that bread deliveries were being made to customers' homes, demonstrating the convenience and flexibility of the bakery's doorstep delivery service. These special events and offerings reflect Hailey's efforts to create engaging experiences for her customers and expand her product range to cater to diverse tastes and needs.
